narrative.overview: The product's one web screen is the visual explorer, served locally for one audited folder. It reads as a native macOS utility window, not as a web dashboard. One toolbar at the top carries every view, the product name sits in it as the window title, and content lies in inset grouped surfaces that hairlines divide. Nothing floats at rest: the window colour shows only in the gutters between insets and behind the TreeMap cells. The window has a light and a dark appearance and follows the system (prefers-color-scheme); the page has no switch of its own. Both appearances are one system. Every token has a value for each under the same name, and a rule takes every colour it shows from a token. Greys carry the window, the surfaces and the text. Accent blue marks selection, focus, links and the active view. The state palette marks status and severity, and nothing else is coloured. The screen is compact: a 13px body on a 1.45 line height, 22px tree rows, 24px fields, 26px push buttons. Control feedback is a fast wash (150ms). Only the inspector, the finding sheet, the toast and the TreeMap zoom move, each in 150 to 200ms.
keyCharacteristics: One toolbar with eight views, an icon over a label, the active view tinted in the accent.
Inset grouped surfaces: 10px radius, one hairline border, a flat fill, no shadow.
Tonal depth: window, alternate strip and surface, divided by hairlines; shadows only under the finding sheet, the toast and the TreeMap tooltip.
A fixed type scale of five steps (11, 12, 13, 15, 28px), semibold titles, monospace for paths, identifiers and code.
Compact controls: 24px fields, 26px push buttons, 22px capsule chips, a segmented control, pop-up buttons.
Two appearances from one set of tokens.
Drawn icons only: 16px SVG with a 1.5 stroke.

rules.name: The Word And Mark Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries a state alone. Every status and severity keeps its word and its drawn mark, and every selection keeps a drawn ring, border or mark beside its tint.

rules.name: The Fill And Text Pair Rule
rules.body: A state colour set as text is its -text twin, never its fill. A state that needs a fill and words gets both tokens.

rules.name: The Declared Steps Rule
rules.body: A font size is one of the five declared steps, from --text-11 to --text-28. The stylesheet sets no other size, and no text is smaller than 11px.

rules.name: The Mono For Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for paths, identifiers, code, measured values and formulas. Prose, labels and titles stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Fixed Window Rule
rules.body: The page never scrolls. Content scrolls inside its panel body, and below 1100px the stacked workspace is the one exception.

rules.name: The One Toolbar Rule
rules.body: Every view is reached from the toolbar at the top. There is no side navigation and no second-level menu.

rules.name: The Inset Rule
rules.body: Content sits in an inset grouped surface. Nothing gets a shadow at rest; the three shadows of the system belong to the sheet, the toast and the tooltip.

rules.name: The Drawn Icon Rule
rules.body: An icon is drawn: 16px SVG with a 1.5 stroke, inline or as a mask over an inline data URI. No emoji, no text glyph and no icon font stand in for an icon. The one raster is the product icon.

dos: **Do** place content in an inset grouped surface: the surface fill, a 10px radius and a 1px separator border, on the window background.
**Do** let a panel body scroll sideways for content wider than its view; its overflow fade marks the cut.
**Do** name a state with its word and its drawn mark, and set its text in the -text token of its colour, never in a fill.
**Do** take hover, press and selection from the shared tokens (surface-hover, surface-active, surface-selected, tint-hover, tint-active) and give every interactive element the 3px focus ring.
**Do** take sizes from the five type steps and set paths, identifiers and code in the mono stack.
**Do** draw a new icon as 16px SVG with a 1.5 stroke and round caps, filled with the colour of its element.
**Do** add a new token in both appearances, under one name, on :root and in the dark block.
**Do** keep control transitions at 150ms and switch them off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: **Don't** convey a status, a severity or a selection by colour alone.
**Don't** show the value of a secret on any surface. Flag the line and keep the value masked.
**Don't** give a resting element a shadow. Shadows belong to the finding sheet, the toast and the TreeMap tooltip.
**Don't** use an emoji, a text glyph or an icon font as an icon.
**Don't** set a font size outside the declared steps, or any text below 11px.
**Don't** add a second accent or re-tint the state colours. One blue is the accent.
**Don't** replace the favicon or the app icon. They are the author's own drawing and change only on the author's request.
**Don't** write a visible colour into a rule. Use the token.
